Reverses the premise of the question: it asserts SCOP 1.75 already carved chain A into four domains, d1acca1 through d1acca4, spread across all-beta folds with aerolysin-like and immunoglobulin-like b.1 placements. SCOP 1.75 had one whole-chain domain d1acca_ in f.11.1.1, and the current parse is two domains, so the classifications, identifiers and hierarchy relationships supporting the whole answer are fabricated. The actual before/after change and the b.179.1 PA14-like and f.60.1 assignments are never identified, and it asserts absence of common origin between modules from differing fold placement. Remaining generic module and per-domain-search discussion rests on the invented parse.
